description: This file defines a template-based data structure and a message exchange class for handling type-length-value (TLV) data serialization and communication. It includes classes for request, response, and buffer management, as well as a core message exchange template that manages data transmission, reception, and synchronization in a networked environment.

classes.name: TypeLengthValueType
classes.description: A template struct implementing TLV (Type-Length-Value) serialization with nested Request, Response, and Buffer classes for managing TLV data segments.

classes.name: MessageExchangeType
classes.description: A template class managing message exchange over a communication channel, including data serialization, synchronization, and state management.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TLV data into a byte stream.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another request object if types match.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into TLV data segments.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next TLV data segment in the buffer.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the message exchange for thread-safe operations.
